title: Perfect Handcrafted 3D Models per Scale and Mode for Every Staffage
description: Completely have perfect handcrafted 3D models for every staffage, different and consistent for each scale and each mode (dark/light line and solid, thermodynamic, forces, moments), end to end: schema, kernel, authoring of all 152 assets, exports, viewer, tests with third-party oracles.
summary: Closed on 2026-11-24 by the umbrella ticket 26/11/22/GET-STAFFAGE-RUNNING-END-TO-END-AND-FINISH-ALL-STAFFAGE-TICKETS. Acceptance measured on the catalog of 375 assets: catalog-silhouette 385/385 (was 183/385 on 2026-11-23; 202 assets repaired in 17 fixer batches, reports `silhouette-*.md` in the umbrella ticket), product check CLI 375/375, three-views 775/775, catalog-physics 840/840, breathing 290/290, asset-validation 83/83, asset-power 24/24, schema-conformance 43/43, plan-projection 13/13, manifest 0 issues. Two shared test edits in the silhouette oracle (reference rasteriser without the 10 MB input limit; polygon reference on an integer grid with retries), no threshold changed. Stated debt: bamboo-clump passes through raster-fitted squares; leaves of agave, hosta-clump, date-palm are slab stacks exact only in the default pose; several people and wheelchair-user pass exactly at the limit; weeping-willow file 9.5 MB; engine requests collected in the umbrella `requests.md`.
